name: The Franco Company
old_description: The Franco Company is a custom furnishing company. We provide made to order pieces of furniture and Art. Our products are hand made in Dallas, TX. We take pride in working providing custom detail to each of our clients and enjoy the one on one interactions with them to create the perfect design.
about:
The Franco Company, based in Rowlett, Texas, was founded in 2015. The business produces custom furniture and art pieces that are handcrafted in nearby Dallas. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed in public materials.

The shop focuses on custom handcrafted furniture, millwork, conference tables, and reception desks. Materials include solid wood, exotic veneers, high-end laminates, and real steel, combined with current manufacturing technology. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Clients span commercial, design, and hospitality sectors. Commercial accounts include American Airlines Center, AT&T Discovery District, and Marriott Hotels. Design-firm partners include Erin Sander Design, Marly & Co, SJL Design, Angeline Guido Design, and Autumn Cooper Design. Local hospitality projects include Lochlands Irish Pub in Lake Highlands, Revolving Kitchen in Fairview, Fortunate Sons in Garland, and Recess Dallas in Lakewood.

The company states that its innovative interpretation of residential and commercial furniture sets it apart, citing the use of premium materials and latest technology. It emphasizes fresh designs and fully customized solutions for conference rooms, lobby areas, reception desks, statement tables, and collaborative workspaces.
